modernopt.screen.title: ModernOPT Settings
modernopt.screen.subtitle: RENDER CONTROL  •  MINECRAFT 1.21.1
modernopt.option.enabled.desc: Master switch for render scaling, upscaling, and anti-aliasing.
modernopt.option.scale.desc: Internal world resolution as a percentage of the window size.
modernopt.option.upscaler.desc: 0 — FSR1, 1 — Bilinear, 2 — Nearest, 3 — SoftScale. Select a render scale below 100% to apply upscaling.
modernopt.option.dynamic.desc: Automatically adjust world resolution toward the target FPS.
modernopt.option.targetfps.desc: Target frame rate from 30 to 540 FPS.
modernopt.option.ssaa.desc: Render at 2x resolution and downsample. Mutually exclusive with FXAA and MSAA.
modernopt.option.fxaa.desc: Post-process anti-aliasing. Mutually exclusive with SSAA and MSAA.
modernopt.option.msaa.desc: Multisample anti-aliasing at 2x, 4x, 8x, or 16x. Mutually exclusive with FXAA and SSAA.
modernopt.benchmark.title: ModernOPT Benchmark
modernopt.benchmark.requirements: Benchmark requires a local single-player world and Spectator mode.
modernopt.profile.title: Render profile
modernopt.profile.desc: Cycle Quality, Balanced, Performance or Custom presets.
